finding.title: No check drives smart_write with no valve write entity; dropping the guard turns a DEBUG skip into a WARNING
finding.claim: With mixing_valve_mode=smart_write and no mixing_valve_write_entity (an accepted, optional option), _command_valve_target's `if not entity_id:` guard returns with a DEBUG line. With the guard removed the write is attempted on None/'' inside _valve_write_problem, fails, and log_held latches a WARNING 'Valve write entity None could not be commanded' each time the condition starts. The full GATE_SCOPE=full GOLDEN_MODE=drift gate does not notice.
finding.metric_definition: WARNING-or-higher log records from one _command_valve_target() call with smart_write and no valve write entity, counted on the custom_components.heatpump_optimizer logger
